visual_logic.color_palette: Military-olive green dorsal side with a pale cream underbelly; dark charcoal 'ramming' rostrum.
visual_logic.pattern_strategy: Mottled slate-grey counter-shading along the flanks with a sharp red 'eye-mask' streak for character appeal.
visual_logic.eyes: Cold, intelligent amber eyes with horizontal pupils.
visual_logic.environment: Vibrant Oceanic Cyan water of the Maastricht; long, horizontal underwater sunbeams cutting across the frame to establish a clear tracking line with sharp caustic patterns on the creature's back.

pose: A full-body horizontal profile view stretching completely from the left edge to the right edge of the frame. The massive 13-to-14-meter body is aligned flat in the lower half of the image, keeping the top half clear so a second species can be drawn or stacked directly above it for side-by-side length comparison. Its long, heavy snout points straight forward, and the sweeping, shark-like tail fluke is positioned horizontally along the profile plane.
